title: Exponential Sigmoid Equation for Modelling Cell Growth in a Confined Space, Log-Normal Distribution for Modelling Cell Area Distribution of Dense Colonies and Other Methods
summary: Based on the growth patterns of 166 CHO monoclones observed over a 15 day period, we show that the standard population growth in a confined space equation, i.e. the sigmoid/logistic function, is alone does not capture the complex behaviour of the cell growth in a confined space. Thus, combining the sigmoid function and the exponential of the sigmoid function, we present a more accurate model for modelling cell growth in a confined space.
